primary_claim: The intrinsic dimension of token representations within a prompt correlates positively with next-token surprisal (cross-entropy loss) across layers in GPT-2, Pythia, Llama, and OPT, and correlates positively with TunedLens latent-prediction entropy in GPT-2 and Pythia, though Llama shows a moderate negative correlation around layer 20 instead.

effect.metric: Pearson correlation (rho) between intrinsic dimension and TunedLens latent prediction entropy
effect.value: rho > 0.5 for GPT-2 (early layers) and Pythia (middle layers onward); rho ~ -0.5 for Llama around layer 20; no positive correlation for Llama/OPT until late layers

stated_future_work: Further understanding of the negative correlation found in LLAMA is left for future work
quote: All four models have a high positive correlation across the layers of the model, implying that prompts with a higher average surprisal have a higher intrinsic dimension.
